verdict.rationale: The plugin marketplace docs state that marketplaces provide "version tracking, automatic updates." The anthropics/skills repo registers as a marketplace via `/plugin marketplace add`, and plugins carry a version in their manifest, so marketplace-installed skills get updates without reinstalling. On the API side, an optional skill `version` parameter and a Skill Versions API cover version management. Missing for 10: no explicit update command documented in the pack, no detail on how or when auto-updates trigger or how to pin or roll back, and no independent or hands-on corroboration that updates work.
